summary: At each w ∈ S, the central unit at w (or w̄) is the embedded scalar, and φ = ψ − z·ψ.

steps.claim: w divides N, so w or w̄ lies in D.piPlaces. In either case the central unit at that place is embedGL of an integral scalar x ≡ 1 off w (exists_embedGL_scalar_eq_scalarFin), and φ = ψ − z·ψ with z that translation (exists_eq_sub_centralGen) — the form required by ramified.
steps.lean:
obtain a | a := (D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.4 _).1 (IsSplitLevel.natCast_mem _ w.2) <;> peel
    exists_embedGL_scalar_eq_scalarFin (n := D.X 0) w ((D.exists_centralGen ⟨_,
    a⟩).choose_spec.1.imp_right (by aesop)) <;> exact (D.exists_eq_sub_centralGen ⟨_, a⟩ r).imp' (↑)
    (by simp_all [conjEmbedGL, ← (commute_scalarFin _).eq, centralGen])
